title: Tom and the Blue Ball
text:
Tom has a big blue ball. He takes it to the park every day. Today, a little dog runs after the ball.

The dog brings the ball back to Tom. Tom laughs and throws it again. They play together until the sun goes down.

questions.text: What does the dog bring back to Tom?
How does Tom probably feel while he plays with the dog?
Why does Tom take his ball to the park every day?
options: Because he likes to play with it
Because he has to work there
Because he wants to buy a dog

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people play
a round object that children and animals play with
makes sounds with the voice because something is funny
moves something through the air using the hand

paragraph_translations: Tom tiene una pelota grande y azul. Él la lleva al parque todos los días. Hoy, un perrito corre detrás de la pelota.
El perro trae la pelota de vuelta a Tom. Tom se ríe y la lanza otra vez. Juegan juntos hasta que se pone el sol.
